decisionsTitle: The chains hand the build list to the builder, not only to the reviewer
decisionsSection:
**What happened, 2026-10-11.** The dispatcher (§368) hands each change to `br-chain` (implement, review, fix, re-review) or `br-fix-round`, and every call carries a `checklist`: the build list, one line per thing that must be true — the files to change, the exact e2e recipe, the tests that must exist, the release entry's fields. Both scripts put `${A.checklist}` into the reviewer's prompt only. The implementer's prompt was the preamble and the `brief`; the fixer's was the findings. So implementers reported «the brief's checklist was not included», skipped e2e runs the list required, and twice put a copy of the main checkout's real `.env.local` into their worktree, because the rule «make it from the secret-free template, never from the main checkout's file» lived in the one place they could not read. The preamble made it worse: its setup line said the worktree's `.env.local` was «copied from the main checkout's». Nothing was committed (the file is git-ignored), but a file of real values sat inside an agent's run.

**Decision.** One list, read by all. `br-chain` puts the `checklist` into the implementer's prompt right after the brief, under «THE BUILD LIST — do every item; the reviewer checks each one, citing file:line», and into its own fix stage's prompt; `br-fix-round` puts it into the fixer's prompt after the findings, under «THE BUILD LIST this branch is judged against — keep every item true while you fix». The reviewers' prompts, the arguments, the schemas and the control flow are unchanged: both scripts were run against a stubbed agent, the stages come out the same, the reviewers' prompts are byte for byte the same, and the list appears once in each builder, fixer and reviewer prompt. The preamble's setup line no longer says to copy the main checkout's `.env.local`: the file is made from the secret-free template the brief or the build list names, never from the main checkout's. `docs/DISPATCHER.md` says in the two cards and in lesson 6 of 2026-10-03 that the builder, the fixer and the reviewer all read the checklist; lesson 6 had said the fixer already did, and it did not.

**Not changed.** The `intent` still reaches the reviewer alone, so the brief embeds it in full (lesson 6).

**Refused.** A second argument for the builder (a «recipes» or «buildList» beside `checklist`): the dispatcher would write the same lines twice, the two lists could drift, and the reviewer would judge a list the builder never saw. One `checklist`, read by the builder, the fixer and the reviewer, is what «the reviewer checks each one» already promised.
changelogLine: - **Internal: the build list reaches the builder** — the dispatcher's `br-chain` and `br-fix-round` gave their `checklist` to the reviewer alone, so implementers never saw the e2e recipes or the rule against copying the main checkout's `.env.local`; the builder, the fixer and the reviewer now all read it, and the setup line no longer says to copy that file. Nothing a visitor or the club sees. §NNN.
